texts.preamble: Jaswant Chaudhary vs State Of U.P. on 4 March, 2025 Author: Samit Gopal Bench: Samit Gopal High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:30667 Court No. - 78 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 2597 of 2013
texts.facts: On suspicion of the same being adulterated he asked for 600 ml of the said milk after which the accused from a container containing 20 liters of boiled milk gave him 600 ml milk on the purchase. The same was ceased as per rules and papers were prepared. The sample of the purchased milk was sent to the Food Analyst who vide his report dated 15.12.1999 opined that the sample was of boiled buffalo milk and was of the opinion that the same as per the standards of buffalo milk was found to be having 53% milk fat less and 49% milk solids non-fat less in it. The same was thus considered to be adulterated and after obtaining sanction from the C.M.O. concerned a complaint dated 19.03.2001 was filed by the Food Analyst before the C.J.M. concerned. 5. Under Section 244 Cr.P.C Murari Lal Yadav the Food Inspector was examined as P.W.-1, V.S. Kushwaha was examined as P.W.-2 and Majeed Khan was examined as P.W.-3. The said persons were examined under Section 246 Cr.P.C. also. 6. The accused in his statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. stated that he has been falsely implicated due to enmity, however, no defence evidence was led.
texts.arguments: 7. Learned counsel for the revisionist submitted that in the present case there is no finding of the trial court concerned that the notice under Section 13 (2) of the Act has been served on the revisionist-accused. It is submitted that the same is a serious violation of his right to be defended adequately. Learned counsel has relied upon the judgement of the Apex Court in the case of Vijendra Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh in Criminal Appeal No. 1167 of 2019 decided on 31.07.2019 and while placing paragraph 15 has submitted the same to buttress his argument. It is submitted that even the P.W.-1 in his cross-examination has stated that no document pertaining to Section 13 (2) of the Act is on record but the trial court although has returned a finding that Exb: Ka-10 is a document for the same which has been proved by P.W.-3. It is submitted that as such there is serious discrepancy and doubt regarding the compliance of Section 13 (2) of the Act. It is further submitted that there is no finding given by the trial court that the notice of Section 13 (2) of the Act as alleged to have been sent has been received by the accused-respondent. It is submitted that as such the valuable right of the accused for defending himself is violated. 8. Learned cousnel for the State although vehemently opposed the present revision but could not dispute the arguments which are based on record.
